title: Member records (cloud)
description: records, connectors and their jobs in the PHI project, read with `cloud-phi` alone. Health numbers only: no member data reaches a metric. Every panel reads Cloud Monitoring metrics: Google's own, and the log-based counters tpa-platform's catalogue defines, whose labels are a closed list. No panel reads a log line.

links.title: PagerDuty incidents
links.tooltip: Open incidents page through PagerDuty; this site cannot list them

panels.title: Requests, by status class
panels.description: Requests Cloud Run answered per interval. A refusal is a 4xx.

panels.title: p95 latency (Cloud Run)
panels.description: records' p95 request latency. `canary-latency` opens above 2 s for ten minutes.

panels.title: Refusals, by gate and code
panels.description: Every refusal the gateway answered, by gate and CONTRACT §7 code (`records_refusals`).

panels.title: Refusals, by gate, code and operation
panels.description: Refusals in the time range, by gate, code and catalogue operation.

panels.title: Audit flush failed, or database unreachable
panels.description: The two lines that mean the gateway is failing its promise (`records-critical`, urgent): a refusal's audit rows did not land, or tpa-db did not answer. From the service or a job.

panels.title: Rate limited, by operation
panels.description: Gate 8's rate limiter refusing a call (`records_rate_limited`).

panels.title: Mirror warnings and errors, by gate
panels.description: The mirror's warnings and errors: gate 2 is the JWKS fetch, gate 3 the event and revocation feeds (`records_mirror_problems`).

panels.title: Database connection errors
panels.description: records lines with a class-08 SQLSTATE (`records-sql-errors`) and the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy's own refusals in this project, services and jobs (`canary-sql`).

panels.title: Instances, and start-up or runtime failures
panels.description: Cloud Run instances of records and connectors, and Cloud Run's system log at ERROR in this project (`canary-startup`).

panels.title: tpa-db
panels.description: Cloud SQL's own signals for tpa-db: `database/up` (the urgent `tpa-db-down` pages below 1 for five minutes) and disk used (`tpa-db-disk` at 85% for ten minutes). "database stopped": stopped on purpose between test sessions (beta's database_activation_policy NEVER; the service's TPA_STOPPED_DATABASES). "not reporting": no value, and not listed as stopped: not built (cc-db exists with the staffed desk only), or reporting nothing.

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: records' 5xx answers per interval. `records-down` (urgent) opens when everything it answered for ten minutes was a 5xx.

panels.title: records-chain-head: executions and schedule
panels.description: Each closed day's chain head written to the vault. A failed execution or schedule pages as `audit-chain` (urgent).

panels.title: A chain head was already in the vault
panels.description: The chain-head job found the latest day's head already written on its first attempt (`chain-head-exists`, normal): written before it (O137), a person's rerun, or the autumn clock change.

panels.title: Delivery passes (the loop's heartbeat)
panels.description: One per pass of the delivery loop, its line matched whole. None for five minutes pages as `connectors-stalled`.

panels.title: Deliveries, by lane and outcome
panels.description: One per send attempt (`connectors_deliveries`). The destination is not a label.

panels.title: Dead letters, refused destinations, unsigned envelopes
panels.description: A row settled dead (`connectors-dead-letters`), a destination outside the allowlist (`connectors-destination-refused`) and a claimed row with no signature (`connectors-envelope-unsigned`).

panels.title: Perimeter violations
panels.description: VPC Service Controls violations logged in this project, by reason, service and whether it was a dry run (`perimeter-violations`).

panels.title: Alert, snooze and log-counter changes
panels.description: Changes to this project's alert policies, notification channels or snoozes (`monitoring-changed`, D-137) and to its log-based counters (`log-counters-changed`, D-141), from the Admin Activity log, by method. The entry says who and what. No resource type is named: the catalogue has not yet confirmed which resource Google writes these on.

panels.title: Executions, by job and result
panels.description: The migration, the nightly export, the chain head, beta's seed and the quarterly restore drill.

panels.title: Schedules that could not start their job
panels.description: Cloud Scheduler is outside the perimeter's restricted services: a refusal here may be the perimeter.
